definition: The Citadel is a navigable symbolic interface for organizing real-world knowledge, personal memory, media collections, technical projects, and life systems.
coreRules: Rooms should represent real-world things, tools, collections, habits, or information systems.
A room can be imaginative in appearance, but its purpose should map to something useful.
Citadel data should be saved in clean, readable JSON or Markdown.
Published GitHub files should use version folders rather than overwriting prior versions.
Targeted file generation is supported when the requested file is clearly named.
